data.name: Viva
data.gender_notes: Viva is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'vivus', meaning 'alive'. This name conveys a sense of vitality and energy. The name Viva carries the meaning “Lively, full of life” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Viva usually hope their child will grow to embody lively, full of life and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of the divine spark within us, representing the flame of life and the fire of the soul.
data.etymology: Viva belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lively, full of life.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Viva total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
